questions.q: What name did Lady Anne give Black Beauty?
choices: Black Auster
Baron
Darkie
Black Prince
questions.evidence: She chose me for her horse, and named me "Black Auster".

questions.q: What kind of rider was Lady Anne?
choices: A perfect horsewoman, gay and gentle
A nervous beginner who had just learned
A cruel rider who always used a whip
A lady who almost never rode out
questions.evidence: She was a perfect horsewoman, and as gay and gentle as she was beautiful.
